about.badge: Our Story & Method in Denver, CO

hero.title: We Treat Your Laundry Like It’s Our Own
hero.subtitle: LaundryGo is Denver's dedicated pickup & delivery laundry service. We turn the weekly chore into effortless freshness with transparent per-pound pricing, eco-friendly care, and door-to-door convenience.

mission.title: More Free Time, Zero Laundry Stress
mission.p1: Founded in Denver, LaundryGo was born out of a simple conviction: laundry shouldn't consume your precious evenings and weekends.
mission.p2: Whether you are a busy parent, a working professional, or a local business, we manage your wash-and-fold routine with high-efficiency eco washers, gentle fabrics care, and dependable doorstep delivery.

process.title: The LaundryGo Process, Explained
process.subtitle: From your doorstep to our washing facilities and back in pristine condition — here is how we handle every load.

step1.title: Easy Online Scheduling & Doorstep Pickup
step1.description: Select your pickup date and choose between Morning (8:00 AM – 11:00 AM) or Afternoon (12:00 PM – 4:00 PM) slots. Place your bags outside or hand them directly to our friendly driver. No credit card is charged upfront.
step1.highlight: Morning & Afternoon windows with $0 delivery in Central Denver.

step2.title: Precision Weighing & Fabric Sorting
step2.description: At our facility, every bag is weighed on calibrated commercial scales so you only pay for your exact poundage. We meticulously sort garments by colors, whites, darks, and delicate fabrics.
step2.highlight: Transparent per-pound pricing with expert color separation.

step3.title: Eco-Friendly Cleaning & Custom Care
step3.description: We wash using biodegradable, hypoallergenic detergents and high-efficiency machines. We apply optional treatments such as Downy scent beads, targeted stain removal, and special cycles for comforters and bedding.
step3.highlight: Eco detergents with optional scent boosts and stain treatments.

step4.title: Fiber-Safe Drying & Boutique Folding
step4.description: Clothes are dried at carefully regulated temperatures to preserve elasticity and prevent shrinkage. Next, our team hand-folds each item into crisp stacks, packaged in weather-safe protective packaging.
step4.highlight: Temperature-controlled drying and neat, ready-for-the-closet folding.

step5.title: Fast Return Straight to Your Door
step5.description: Your clean, fresh-smelling laundry is delivered back to your home or business right on time based on your speed: Standard (2 days), Go (Next-day), or GoFurther (Same-day express if ordered before 12 PM).
step5.highlight: Punctual delivery with real-time status updates in your dashboard.

businessRules.title: Our Core Business Model & Commitments
businessRules.subtitle: Clear guidelines and honest pricing that make LaundryGo simple, reliable, and fair.

rule1.title: Fair Per-Pound Rates & $40 Min.
rule1.description: We bill by actual weight ($2.25/lb Standard, $2.45/lb Go next-day, $3.85/lb Same-day express). A $40 minimum order applies to laundry services.

rule2.title: Same-Day Cutoff at 12:00 PM
rule2.description: Need same-day turnaround? Book before 12:00 PM with 'GoFurther' and receive your fresh clothes back the very same day.

rule3.title: 7.5% Recurring Savings
rule3.description: Set up a daily, weekly, fortnightly, or monthly recurring pickup and get an automatic 7.5% discount on all service rates from your 2nd pickup.

rule4.title: Denver Metro Coverage
rule4.description: Free $0 delivery in Central Denver, Lakewood, Englewood, Wheat Ridge, and Arvada. Outer metro areas (Aurora, Thornton, etc.) have a $25 delivery fee.

values.title: Why Denver Trusts LaundryGo
values.subtitle: We blend modern convenience with old-fashioned personal care.

item1.title: Zero Hidden Fees
item1.description: Transparent pricing with no surprises. You pay only after your laundry is weighed.

item2.title: 100% Clean Guarantee
item2.description: If any item isn't cleaned to your standards, we'll re-wash it immediately at no cost.

item3.title: Hypoallergenic & Eco-Safe
item3.description: We use dermatologically-tested, biodegradable detergents safe for all skin types and fabrics.

item4.title: Personalized Preferences
item4.description: Custom wash temperatures, fragrance options, and special requests honored on every order.

cta.title: Ready for Effortless, Fresh Laundry?
cta.subtitle: Schedule your pickup in under 60 seconds and let LaundryGo take care of the rest.
